meaning: The current situation of a task or project.
ex: Can you give me the status of the export feature?

meaning: Something that is more important and must be done first.
vi: sự ưu tiên, việc ưu tiên
ex: What's my top priority this week, the report or the bug fixes?

meaning: The amount of work a person has to do.
ex: My workload is pretty heavy this sprint.

meaning: Being fully responsible for a task and its result.
vi: tinh thần làm chủ, trách nhiệm
ex: I really like the ownership you showed on this module.

meaning: A formal meeting where your manager evaluates how well you have worked.
vi: đánh giá hiệu suất, đánh giá năng lực
ex: My performance review is scheduled for the end of this month.

meaning: A private regular meeting between a manager and one team member.
ex: Let's talk about it in our one-on-one on Thursday.

meaning: The person who is in charge of a team and its work.
ex: I'll check with my manager before I change the plan.

meaning: The person who guides a team or a part of a project.
ex: Our team lead asked everyone to update their tickets.

meaning: To give someone a task or job to do.
ex: Could you assign the new bug to me?

meaning: Earlier than planned.
vi: vượt tiến độ, sớm hơn kế hoạch
ex: Good news, the reporting module is ahead of schedule.

meaning: To talk with someone briefly to see how things are going.
vi: hỏi thăm tình hình, trao đổi nhanh
ex: I just wanted to check in about the timeline.

meaning: A short meeting to share information and agree on next steps.
vi: buổi trao đổi nhanh, họp sync
ex: Do you have ten minutes for a quick sync after lunch?

meaning: To talk with someone to share recent news or progress.
vi: trao đổi, cập nhật tình hình
ex: Can we catch up later today about my tasks?

meaning: A day when you do not go to work.
ex: Would it be okay if I took a day off next Monday?

meaning: A period when you are allowed to be away from work.
ex: I'd like to request some time off in December.

meaning: Time off work because you are ill.
ex: Lan is on sick leave today, so I'll cover her review.

meaning: A polite or official act of asking for something.
ex: I submitted a request to work from home next week.

meaning: Extra time you work beyond your normal hours.
vi: làm thêm giờ, tăng ca, OT
ex: I'd rather not do overtime again this weekend if possible.

meaning: Extreme tiredness caused by working too hard for too long.
ex: I'm worried about burnout if we keep working these hours.

meaning: Feeling that you have too much work to handle.
ex: Honestly, I feel a bit overwhelmed with three projects at once.

meaning: Having the job of taking care of something.
ex: Who is responsible for testing the mobile version?

meaning: To have difficulty doing something.
ex: I sometimes struggle with the new reporting requirements.

meaning: Unable to make progress with something.
ex: I've been stuck on this payment bug since yesterday.

meaning: An explanation that makes something clearer.
ex: I need some clarification on the acceptance criteria.

meaning: Agreement between people about goals or plans.
ex: We need better alignment between our team and the design team.

meaning: To bring up a topic or problem for discussion.
ex: I want to raise an issue about our review process.

meaning: To point out a possible problem so that others notice it.
ex: I wanted to flag that the requirements changed again yesterday.

meaning: Extra time allowed to finish something.
ex: Would it be possible to get a two-day extension on this?

meaning: To fall behind the planned date or time.
ex: The release date might slip if we don't get the designs this week.

meaning: Having very little time available.
ex: The timeline is tight, but I think we can make it.

meaning: To politely resist or disagree with a request or plan.
vi: phản đối, từ chối (một cách lịch sự)
ex: I'd like to push back a little on this deadline.

meaning: To have a different opinion from someone.
ex: I respectfully disagree; I think we should fix the bugs first.

meaning: A particular way of thinking about something.
ex: From my perspective, the main problem is unclear requirements.

meaning: A change that makes something better.
vi: sự cải thiện, sự tiến bộ
ex: I've seen a big improvement in your code reviews lately.

meaning: A specific aim that you plan to achieve.
ex: What's the main objective for our team this quarter?

meaning: Public praise or thanks for someone's work.
vi: sự ghi nhận, sự công nhận
ex: Your team deserves recognition for finishing the release on time.

meaning: Open and honest, not hiding information.
ex: I want to be transparent: I won't finish this by Friday.

meaning: The level of confidence and happiness in a team.
ex: Team morale has been low since the last deadline crunch.

meaning: To pass a task to another person so they can continue it.
ex: Can I hand off the reporting task to Tuan while I'm away?

meaning: To do someone's work while they are away.
ex: Hoa will cover for me while I'm on leave.

meaning: To work together with one other person on the same task.
ex: Maybe I could pair up with Nam to finish this faster.

meaning: To contact someone, often to ask for help.
ex: Feel free to reach out if you get stuck.

meaning: To continue giving someone updates about a situation.
vi: cập nhật thường xuyên cho anh/chị
ex: I'll keep you posted on the progress of the fix.

meaning: Temporarily stopped or delayed.
ex: The search feature is on hold until we get feedback.

meaning: Currently being worked on and not finished yet.
ex: The login ticket is still in progress, about 70% done.

meaning: Completely finished.
ex: The settings page is done and ready for testing.

meaning: Nearly but not completely.
ex: I'm almost finished with the checkout screen.

meaning: Approximately; not exactly.
ex: It will take roughly two more days to finish.

meaning: Used to say what you hope will happen.
ex: I'll hopefully have a draft ready by tomorrow morning.

meaning: Before the end of the current working day.
ex: I'll send you the summary by end of day.

meaning: Without being stopped or affected by something.
ex: We finished on time despite the late requirement changes.

meaning: Used to introduce a fact that contrasts with the main point.
ex: I can take it, although it might delay my other task.

meaning: Used to compare two facts that are different.
ex: The UI part is done, whereas the testing hasn't started yet.

meaning: At the same time while something else is happening.
ex: I'm waiting for access; meanwhile, I'm writing the test plan.

meaning: In spite of what has just been said.
ex: It's a tough deadline; nevertheless, I'll do my best.

meaning: Not having enough people to do the work.
ex: We're understaffed this month with two people on leave.

meaning: To think something will take less time or effort than it really does.
vi: đánh giá thấp, ước tính thấp
ex: I tend to underestimate how long testing takes.

meaning: To promise to do more work than you can actually handle.
vi: nhận quá nhiều việc, cam kết quá sức
ex: I don't want to overcommit and then miss the deadline.

meaning: To handle several tasks or responsibilities at the same time.
vi: xoay xở nhiều việc cùng lúc
ex: It's hard to juggle support tickets and feature work.

meaning: To control every small detail of someone's work too closely.
vi: quản lý vi mô, quản lý quá chi tiết
ex: I don't want to micromanage you, so just tell me if you need help.

meaning: The number of people working in a team or company.
vi: số lượng nhân sự, định biên
ex: We can't take on this project without more headcount.

meaning: Freedom to make your own decisions about your work.
ex: I'd appreciate more autonomy in choosing how to solve problems.

meaning: Some freedom or extra time to do something the way you want.
vi: sự linh động, khoảng dư (thời gian)
ex: Is there any leeway on the Friday deadline?

meaning: The freedom to decide what should be done in a situation.
vi: quyền tự quyết, sự tùy ý
ex: I'll leave the order of the tasks to your discretion.

meaning: How regularly something happens, such as meetings or updates.
ex: Should we change the cadence of our one-on-ones to every two weeks?

meaning: Honest and direct, even when the truth is uncomfortable.
ex: Thanks for the candid feedback; it really helps me improve.

meaning: To make a bad situation worse.
ex: Adding more people now might exacerbate the delay.

meaning: An event where people come together to discuss something.
ex: Can we move our weekly meeting to the afternoon?

meaning: A plan that shows when tasks or events will happen.
ex: My schedule is pretty full until Wednesday.

meaning: Having a lot of things to do.
ex: I'm a bit busy today, but I can help tomorrow morning.

meaning: To complete a piece of work.
ex: I plan to finish the search page by Thursday.

meaning: A period of time when you rest and do not go to work.
ex: I'll be on vacation from the 20th to the 27th.

meaning: A set of steps you decide on in order to do something.
ex: My plan for today is to fix the two bugs from QA.

meaning: A written or spoken description of what has happened or been done.
ex: I'll send you the weekly report before Friday noon.

meaning: A short statement of the main points.
ex: Here's a quick summary of what I did yesterday.

meaning: To help someone remember something they need to do.
ex: Could you remind me to submit my leave form?

meaning: To talk about something with other people.
ex: Can we discuss my workload in our next one-on-one?

meaning: A choice that you make after thinking about it.
ex: I need a decision on which option to build first.

meaning: What you think or believe about something.
ex: In my opinion, we should test the old flow first.

meaning: Telling the truth and not hiding anything.
ex: Please be honest with me if the timeline isn't working.

meaning: The act of allowing someone to do something.
ex: Do I need your permission to join the training next week?

meaning: Help or encouragement given to someone.
ex: Thanks for your support during the busy release week.

meaning: An opinion about what someone should do.
ex: Can I get your advice on how to handle this request?

meaning: A situation in which people have the same opinion or accept a plan.
ex: We reached an agreement to split the task between Minh and me.

meaning: Not present at work or at a meeting.
ex: Linh is absent today, so I'll give her update.

meaning: Happening once every week.
ex: Should I add this to our weekly status call?

meaning: To finish doing something.
ex: I expect to complete the first draft by Wednesday.

meaning: A short general description of a situation without details.
ex: Can you give me an overview of where the project stands?

meaning: A person who works in the same team as you.
vi: đồng đội, thành viên cùng nhóm
ex: My teammate is helping me with the tricky part.

meaning: To give someone confidence or support to do something.
ex: I encourage you to present this at the team meeting.

meaning: Words that show approval or admiration for someone's work.
ex: The product owner had a lot of praise for your demo.

meaning: A day you take off work because you are ill.
ex: I need to take a sick day today, I have a fever.

meaning: To do your job at home instead of at the office.
ex: Is it okay if I work from home on Thursday?

meaning: Away from work and not available.
vi: vắng mặt, không có ở văn phòng
ex: I'll be out of office tomorrow for a family event.

meaning: To take a task and start working on it.
ex: After this I'll pick up the next ticket in the list.

meaning: To reply to someone later with an answer.
vi: phản hồi lại, trả lời sau
ex: Let me check and get back to you after lunch.

meaning: To fail to do work as quickly as planned.
ex: I'm starting to fall behind because of all the meetings.

meaning: Happening at the planned time.
ex: Everything is on schedule for the Friday demo.

meaning: To examine or check something to find out more.
ex: I'll look into the issue and update you this afternoon.

meaning: Used when you are about to say what you really think.
ex: My first estimate was, to be honest, a bit too optimistic.

meaning: To give a share of time, money or people for a particular purpose.
ex: Could we allocate one more person to the reporting work?

meaning: Official permission or agreement for something.
ex: I'm still waiting for approval on my leave request.

meaning: To give a task to a different person.
ex: Can you reassign this ticket to Duc while I'm away?

meaning: The person who is given a particular task.
ex: Who is the assignee for the login bug?

meaning: A separate area of work inside a larger project.
vi: mảng công việc, luồng công việc
ex: I'm leading the reporting workstream this quarter.

meaning: Having more work than you can handle.
ex: I'm a bit overloaded, so could someone else take the new request?

meaning: Praise or recognition for something someone has done.
ex: Hung deserves the credit for solving that issue.

meaning: A formal evaluation of an employee's work.
vi: đánh giá nhân viên, đánh giá định kỳ
ex: My annual appraisal is next week, so I'm preparing some notes.

meaning: An evaluation you write about your own work and performance.
ex: I've finished my self-assessment for the mid-year review.

meaning: Able to be trusted to do what is expected.
ex: You've been very dependable this quarter, thank you.

meaning: A period when someone is away from work.
ex: Who will handle my tasks during my absence?

meaning: To formally tell someone about something.
ex: Please notify me if anything changes with the timeline.

meaning: To ask someone for advice or information before deciding.
vi: tham khảo ý kiến, hỏi ý kiến
ex: I'll consult the designer before changing the layout.

meaning: Ideas, advice or information that you give to help something.
ex: I'd really like your input on this plan before I share it.

meaning: Honestly and directly, even if it is not what people want to hear.
vi: nói thẳng ra, thẳng thắn mà nói
ex: I think, frankly, the scope is too big for two weeks.

meaning: Involving doing things yourself rather than only watching or managing.
vi: thực hành, trực tiếp tham gia
ex: I'd like more hands-on experience with leading a feature.

meaning: A short public thanks or praise for someone.
vi: lời cảm ơn công khai, lời khen ngợi
ex: Big shout-out to Mai for helping me with testing.

meaning: A rough estimate that is not exact.
vi: con số ước chừng, ước lượng sơ bộ
ex: Can you give me a ballpark for how long this will take?

meaning: To get familiar with new work so you can be productive.
ex: I'm still trying to ramp up on the new module.

meaning: To meet briefly to share updates and agree on next steps.
vi: trao đổi đồng bộ, họp nhanh
ex: Let's sync up after lunch about the new priorities.

meaning: To move unfinished work to the next period.
ex: We'll need to carry over two tickets to the next sprint.

meaning: To accept a new task or responsibility.
ex: I can take on one more small task this week.

meaning: To say what you think openly, especially about a problem.
ex: Please speak up early if you think a deadline is unrealistic.

meaning: To take more responsibility, especially when it is needed.
vi: đứng ra gánh vác, chủ động nhận trách nhiệm
ex: Thanks for being willing to step up while Nam was away.

meaning: In danger of failing or being late.
ex: The Friday release is at risk because of the late designs.

meaning: To change the order of importance of tasks.
vi: sắp xếp lại thứ tự ưu tiên
ex: Should I reprioritize my tasks now that the request is urgent?

meaning: To make a task less important so it can be done later.
ex: Can we deprioritize the settings page to focus on payments?

meaning: To do less well than expected.
vi: làm việc dưới kỳ vọng, kém hiệu quả
ex: I don't want to underperform, so please tell me where I can improve.

meaning: Having far too much work to deal with.
ex: I'm swamped this week with support requests.

meaning: An extra goal that is hard to reach but possible with extra effort.
vi: mục tiêu thử thách, mục tiêu vượt mức
ex: Finishing the export feature is a stretch goal for this sprint.

meaning: Moving between different tasks often, which wastes time and focus.
vi: chuyển đổi qua lại giữa nhiều việc
ex: Too much context switching is slowing me down this week.

meaning: The act of giving tasks or responsibility to other people.
vi: sự giao việc, sự ủy quyền
ex: Better delegation would help you avoid working late every day.

meaning: The act of completing something you started or promised.
vi: sự làm đến nơi đến chốn
ex: Your follow-through on action points has really improved.

meaning: Being responsible for your actions and their results.
ex: I appreciate the accountability you showed after the incident.

meaning: To learn new skills, especially for your job.
ex: I'd like to upskill in project management next year.
